title: setFsmAxisRates
description: Starts, updates, or stops continuous runtime FSM axis-rate control. Rates are degrees per second; zero rates stop the active lease and freeze the actuator at its current state.

type.description: Command discriminator. Use canonical 'setFsmAxisRates' in newly generated commands.

observer.description: Observatory/site name that owns the target actuator or sensor.

axes.description: FSM axis rates in degrees per second, commonly tip and tilt.
